header: Two or three panels that split readers by how they want to buy
subheader: Each panel names who it is for and where it leads.
lead: Panels get identical weight on purpose. A card is a link target as a whole when its entry carries a link, and the title supplies the accessible name.
note: The note is the line that holds for every route — the one thing the fork does not split.

paths.title: Self-serve
paths.description: The route for a reader who would rather start than talk.

paths.title: Talk to sales
paths.description: The route for a reader who needs a person before a decision.

paths.title: Through a partner
paths.description: The route for a reader who already buys through somebody else.
